name: fullstack-agents
description: Unified fullstack development toolkit with 29 AI agents, 8 commands, and 24 skill domains for FastAPI, Rust/Axum, Next.js, Docker, Celery, WebSocket, and more. Polyglot microservices with strict Python/Rust language-lane separation, clean architecture + DDD in both languages, and wire-contract parity behind one Next.js frontend. Auto-triggers via SessionStart hook with enforced validation gates (PostToolUse ruff/rustfmt, Stop ruff+clippy+tsc+file-size) and a senior-engineer discipline for duplication prevention.
